title: Reference: 200 ms windows, 95 % overlap, in time order, state reset
description: The setting every other entry of this study changes in exactly one way: 20 steps of 10 ms (200 ms), a new window every 10 ms (95 % overlap), windows fed in time order (no shuffling), LSTM state reset at every window. Everything else as the reference: Active torque (each session's own relaxed-hold passive torque subtracted), EMG ÷ session-1 maximum, no per-angle loss scaling (plain mean-squared error, every angle weighted by its own torque), LSTM 16 units × 2 layers, dropout 0.0, learning rate 0.01 (chosen by a validation-loss search), trained with batch 64 for at most 150 epochs (fast protocol: learning rate × 0.5 after 6 flat epochs, early stop 15, at most 150 epochs), trained on session 1 and tested on session 2, 6 people × 10 seeds. The EMG envelope is causal (forward-only filters: no input uses later EMG, as in a real-time device; 2nd-order 2 Hz low-pass, about 125 ms lag) and the first and last 1 s of every trial are cut. Validation windows start one window span after the training part of each trial, so no validation window reuses training inputs (purged split).
